note: Circle (player clubs), slices 1-3. Cherry-made: the creation product (code and name, both shown only in Cherry's replies), its price (5000 Gems, paymentType GEM, decided by the user 2026-11-01), the base member cap (30), every id in this file (circle ids are in the Cherry block 1940000000-1940000999, economy.CherryCircleFirst/Last; logo and background ids in 1940001000-1940001999, economy.CherryCircleArtFirst/Last). The circle room is ORIGINAL (2026-11-17): room.map 2012221744 is the original cat hot spa room from the robo iOS cache (Library/Caches/circle/2012221744.mworldpack: 60 x 60 tiles, 96 furnished objects of 39 interior items), delivered as the pack static/circle/2012221744.mworldpack and named by its bare id (the client opens files/circle/<id>.mworldpack). room.map_size 60 and room.spawn (40, 42) are the pack's own grid size and AVATAR_START (original too). Until 2026-11-17 the room was the LINE Cafe Square map 2202250100 as a stand-in (user decision 2026-11-01). Original (2026-11-21): the pictures. The client's default pair (UIResource/UIImage_hd/circle_logo_sd_dp.png = the symbol, circle_logo_bg_dp.png = the pink background) keeps the first id of each list; the robo iOS cache's 23 symbols (cache/circle_symbol_image/circle_logo_sb_<N>.png) and 18 backgrounds (circle_logo_bg_<M>.png) follow, read from the store and served by file name at /cherry/circle/<name>. The 42 circle_logo_sb_<N>_bg_<M>.png files of that cache are NOT original: the client draws each symbol-on-background picture itself (NaCircleSymbolMgr::CreateCircleImageRenderTexture_ saves it into the cache), so Cherry neither serves nor uploads them. Logo ids 1940001001-1940001024 and background ids 1940001101-1940001119 are Cherry-made. The interest categories are not here: the client hard-codes them (NaCircleDataManager::InitData 0x24e1228), so economy/circle.go lists them in code. Slice 3, Cherry-made except the mission type and text (the client's, below): points.season_days (14), points.season_start (2026-11-02, so circles formed on launch day 2026-11-01 are eligible for season 1; points before the start count toward season 1), points.season_name (the title format), points.daily_cap (60), every trigger's points and per_day, points.steps (targets and Gem rewards), every mission's stage, Gems and points (the mission is the client's type 2, 'Clear Stage %s for Circle points!', arts 5485; the step each mission names is a Cherry choice; the stages are point steps of points.steps, in order), every upgrade (codes, caps, Gem prices; the caps 40 and 50 follow the base 30) and gacha.enabled (the circle page offers the main Cherry Gacha; its odds and prices are data/gacha.json's). The client's own limits and field names are used as they are; the upgrade shop's picture is the circle's default background.
